prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ALTERNATIVE production sprite atlas of raw alchemy ingredients for a medieval nautical fantasy pixel RPG called Royal Alchemist. Original hand-painted pixel art with crisp warm dark outlines and rich highlights, readable at 40 pixels tall. EXACTLY 16 separate ingredient icons on genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha in a perfectly regular SQUARE 4 columns by 4 rows atlas. Every ROW is ONE ingredient family with four recognizable but distinct VARIANTS / evolutionary tiers, left to right, from common to rare. Do not merely enlarge identical icons: vary their naturally related form, branching, texture and details while preserving the ingredient identity. ROW 1 GREEN MEDICINAL ROOT: tier1 small forked tan root with one green shoot; tier2 twisted double root with two green shoots; tier3 branching knotted root with richer green foliage; tier4 intricate ancient root with a curled root tip and a small luminous green bud, still clearly the same root species. ROW 2 RED MUSHROOM: tier1 small round red mushroom with ivory stem; tier2 taller red mushroom with pale spots; tier3 paired mature red mushrooms with curved caps and matching pale spots; tier4 rare wide ruffled red mushroom with layered cap and the same pale spots, all clearly the same mushroom family. ROW 3 BLUE SPIRAL SEASHELL: tier1 simple small blue spiral shell; tier2 longer blue spiral shell with more whorls; tier3 fuller ridged blue spiral shell with iridescent pale-blue lip; tier4 intricate blue spiral shell with elegant natural ridges and a pearly blue lip, still clearly a spiral seashell, not a pearl, fish or gemstone. ROW 4 GOLDEN AMBER: tier1 small rough honey-amber fragment; tier2 faceted natural amber chunk with a trapped seed; tier3 larger amber piece with a tiny fern inclusion; tier4 rich fossil amber with a tiny insect inclusion and refined golden highlights, all raw resin stones, no metal or jewelry. Four clearly matching variants per row, ingredient silhouettes visually different enough to recognize the tiers. Keep family palettes green, red, blue and honey-gold. Compact icons, tier 1 about 45% of its cell, tier 4 at most 65% of its cell. Centers exactly at x 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% and y 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Transparent gutters around EVERY icon including outermost edges. Nothing crosses a cell boundary. No bottles, flasks, potions, jars, containers, frames, jewelry settings, lettering, numbers, grid lines, background, floor shadow, glow outside silhouettes, haze, stray pixels or watermark. No imitation of any existing game's particular icons.
refinement: Refine this exact 16-ingredient sprite atlas for production. Preserve all sixteen root, red mushroom, blue spiral shell and golden fossil amber designs, their four coherent progressive variants per row, colors and hand-painted pixel art style. ONLY fix atlas spacing and transparency. Square canvas, exact regular 4x4 equal cells. Center icons at x and y 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Shrink/reposition every icon, especially tier4 roots, mushrooms, shells and amber, so the entire sprite fits INSIDE the central 65% of its cell width AND central 65% of its cell height. Leave a minimum fully transparent margin of 17.5% of the cell on EACH side. No pixel crosses a cell boundary, no icon touches the canvas edge, no adjacent icons overlap. Remove ALL red, yellow and blue outer speckles, external halos, background remnants, haze and glow outside the actual solid ingredient silhouettes. All empty space must be completely transparent alpha, with clean tight edges around icons. No text, numbers, grid, border, floor shadow or new objects. Keep the smaller first tiers distinct from the richer fourth tiers without sacrificing the generous transparent gutters.
